description: Practice coverage gap matrix v2. Combines Task 25 JainQQ candidates with Task 26 Jainebooks candidates.

practices.strongest_source: JB-001 (Look-N-Learn Samayik by Namramuni Maharaj — confirmed Sthanakvasi Muni)
practices.evidence: Author confirmed as Sthanakvasi Muni on Jainebooks. English practice guide.
practices.remaining_gap: No standalone Samayik pravachan or meditation guide. JB-001 is educational, not discourse.

practices.strongest_source: JB-002 (Shravak Pratikraman — English) + JAINQQ-002489 (Prakrit mool + Hindi)
practices.teacher_or_lineage: Multiple sources, tradition unverified for Jainebooks entries
practices.evidence: 6 Jainebooks candidates + 3 JainQQ candidates. Practice coverage is now STRONG.
practices.remaining_gap: Sthanakvasi-specific Pratikraman pravachan. Most Jainebooks entries have unverified tradition.

practices.evidence: No new Jainebooks candidates found for Kayotsarga.
practices.remaining_gap: No standalone Kayotsarg meditation guide. No teacher commentary. Only canonical text reference.

practices.evidence: JB-008 is Vandittu Pratikraman (not Vandana-specific). Still limited.
practices.remaining_gap: No standalone Vandana explanation or teacher commentary.

practices.evidence: No new Jainebooks candidates for Pratyakhyan.
practices.remaining_gap: No standalone Pratyakhyan explanation or teacher commentary.

practices.evidence: Chauvisantho is covered in the Avashyak Sutra but no standalone text found.
practices.remaining_gap: NO STANDALONE CHAUVISANTHO TEXT. Need Chauvisantho + explanation.

practices.strongest_source: JAINQQ-002489 (complete Avashyak Sutra) + JB-003/010/011 (trilingual Pratikraman Avashyak)
practices.evidence: Strongest practice coverage. 4 new Jainebooks candidates. Trilingual (Eng+Hin+Guj).
practices.remaining_gap: Part 2 of Avashyak Sutra may exist. Teacher commentary beyond Amarmuni.

practices.evidence: NO CANDIDATES FOUND on either platform.
practices.remaining_gap: CRITICAL: No Sthanakvasi Paryushan liturgy, practice guide, or pravachan found anywhere.
